body: Green Bay Packers are actively exploring trade scenarios for veteran defensive linemen, with specific interest in Indianapolis Colts players and a potential $30 million option for a Pro Bowl tackle amid team salary cap concerns. Reports also indicate the team is mulling a decision regarding Kevin Zeitler ahead of a reunion with Detroit.

findings.evidence_quote: Packers Mull Kevin Zeitler Decision Ahead of Lions Reunion
